displayName: sedaia-api: Cloud Run HTTP 5xx rate above 5 percent

documentation.content: Symptom: Cloud Run 5xx responses exceeded 5% for five minutes with meaningful traffic. Inspect Cloud Run revision logs for service sedaia-api in us-central1. Roll back when errors correlate with the active revision and cannot be mitigated promptly. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="sedaia-api" AND resource.label.location="us-central1" AND metric.label.response_code_class="5xx"
conditionThreshold.denominatorFilter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="sedaia-api" AND resource.label.location="us-central1"

conditions.displayName: At least 20 requests in five minutes
